course_summary:
ISEN 691 | Research | Spring 2026
Instructor: Thomas Ferris | tferris@tamu.edu
Meets: coordinated meetings each week in the HF&CS lab; larger project meetings (held at separate times most weeks)
Grading: Midterm deliverable [30%], Final deliverable [50%], Weekly meeting attendance and updates [20%] — A: 90-100%, B: 80-89%, C: 70-79%, D: 60-69%, F: <60%
Topics: Rubberhand project, HF&CS lab, experimental protocol design, IRB approval, human-subjects study, results compilation, technical report writing, human subjects data collection, peer-reviewed journal outlets, statistical testing, human perception mechanisms, human performance effects induction, peer-reviewed publication submission, recruitment planning, Midterm results presentation, statistical analyses, journal article drafting, Introduction material, Methods material, Results material, Discussion material, final report refinement, final report revision, literature collection, literature review, data collection, data analysis, lab presentations, progress updates, project meetings, interdisciplinary collaborators, testing, research project, industrial engineering field, research
